study type: Retrospective study with derivation and validation cohorts
cohort: The study participants consisted of high-risk pregnant women for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent placental MRI.
finding: MRI-based scoring models, established through quantitative meta-analysis, can accurately predict placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), placenta percreta, and adverse peripartum outcome.
cross-section timing: MRI scans were performed during pregnancy.
